verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is that Anthropic publishes system cards and safety-testing summaries on its transparency hub, covering risk areas such as malicious computer use. That suggests some first-party disclosure of model risks. Nothing in the pack shows the developer docs describing capability weaknesses, known failure modes or tasks the model handles poorly. Community reports of bad behaviour (e.g. Haiku going in the wrong direction) are user-sourced, not vendor documentation, so they don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: developer-doc pages listing known limitations and failure modes, per-model weakness or jagged-edge guidance, evidence that the system card covers capability shortfalls beyond safety risks, and independent corroboration of the vendor's candor.
